waypoints.name: SR-20 Hairpin / Pond Pullout (east of Washington Pass)
waypoints.note: Pullout at the SR-20 hairpin east of Washington Pass; walk back toward the pass to the pond where the East Face climbers' path starts.
waypoints.directions: Drive SR-20 to the large hairpin turn just east of Washington Pass and park at the pullout on the curve. Walk back up the road toward the pass to the small pond on the south side of the highway, where the climbers' path starts.

waypoints.name: Liberty Bell Mountain
waypoints.note: Classic Liberty Crack finishes up the Beckey Route's upper pitches to the true summit.
